# Final Experiment Design (DESIGN-ONLY — kuch bhi run nahi kiya gaya, koi result/outcome claim nahi hai)

**Status note:** Neeche ke saare numeric thresholds, grid values, budgets **proposed design parameters** hain (pre-registration ke liye), observations ya predictions nahi. Jahan maine aapke suggestion se difference liya hai, wahan **[DIVERGES-FROM-RESEARCHER-SUGGESTION: ...]** mark hai.

---

## 1. Objective aur pre-registered hypotheses

Question ke 3 logically independent claims hain; design inhe alag-alag falsify karta hai:
- **H1 (property):** chemical feedback (p-logP/cLogP, QED, binding affinity) se generated molecules ke property scores improve hote hain.
- **H2 (hallucination):** feedback se molecular-hallucination rate kam hota hai.
- **H3 (alignment + diversity):** feedback generator distribution ko real-world reference distribution ke closer le jata hai **aur** structural diversity preserve karta hai (ultra-long carbon chains ka over-representation nahi).

**Critical nulls jo design specifically test karta hai:**
- **N-truncation:** H1/H3 ka gain feedback-training se nahi, sirf post-hoc selection se aata hai → **A6** (matched-count top-k filter) feedback arms ko match karega.
- **N-diversity-mechanism:** gain feedback se nahi, diversity-preserving mechanism (repulsion/Pareto) se aata hai → **A2 vs A5** separation.
- **N-hacking:** property gain surrogate over-optimization hai, real affinity/quality improvement nahi → **mandatory** surrogate→independent-rescoring transfer gap diagnostic.
- **N-placebo:** gain kisi bhi reward shaping se aata hai, content se nahi → **A7** shuffled/identity reward.

---

## 2. Setup

**Generator (assumed external asset):** ek standard public generator family, chhota (≤ ~50M param) taaki CPU-viable rahe — SMILES Transformer / JT-VAE / GFlowNet (Trajectory-Balance) / GCPN-style. **Primary generator = GFlowNet-TB + ek RL-tuned Transformer, do models** (model-family generalization; model-2 ek reduced grid par). Ye choice assumption hai, brief se fixed nahi.

**Feedback signal tiers:**
- **Inner-loop surrogate (fast):** differentiable/heuristic — RDKit cLogP, QED, SA, aur ek trained target-conditioned affinity GNN surrogate.
- **Audit tier (fixed, independent):** AutoDock-**Vina** docking score + **dusri independent scoring function** (rescoring on fixed poses: e.g. RF-Score/EquiVin-style ya smina ka alag scoring term) + independent cheminformatics re-implementation (Mordred descriptors).
- Feedback arms **surrogate** par train/guide hote hain; **Vina sirf audit/oracle tier** par (budget realism, §7). [DIVERGES-FROM-RESEARCHER-SUGGESTION: docking-in-loop ko sirf **A8** ke ek chhote extended arm ke roop me rakha gaya hai, primary grid me nahi — CPU-only budget aur surrogate-exploitation ko isolate karne ke liye.]

**Target:** default **single well-established receptor** (pre-computed receptor grid file); panel nahi. *Illustrative, not mandated:* DRD2 / ESR1 / 3D7 jaisa koi ek, source-supported reason ke saath final hoga. **Multi-target panel = explicitly optional extension arm (X-PANEL)** — primary endpoint panel ke bina fully evaluatable hai.

**Reference corpora — do regimes (design feature; ambiguity chhupi nahi):**
- **R-BIO:** bioactive/drug-like (ChEMBL-like, activity-annotated).
- **R-MK:** makeable/purchasable (Enamine-REAL-like / GDB-style enumerated makeable space).
- **Primary alignment regime = R-BIO** (pre-specified, kyunki sawaal "targeted molecule discovery" ke baare me hai). R-MK **secondary + interaction** role: lipophilicity/chain-length par expectations opposite hain (chain inflation R-BIO par artifact, R-MK par legitimate space), isliye har artifact verdict **regime-conditional** report hoga, aur "regime-dependent artifact inversion" ek first-class reported outcome hai, confound nahi.

---

## 3. Arms aur controls

**Primary factor (stated assumption, confirmed source fact nahi): feedback injection point** — *E1* training-time (RL reward / TB-loss reweighting, KL-to-reference β ke saath) · *E2* inference-time (value-guided beam / annealed resample; weights frozen) · *E3* hybrid.

| Arm | Content | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **A0** | No-feedback pretrained baseline (+ KL anchor) | Reference policy; diversity/alignment anchor |
| **A1** | Single-property feedback: {cLogP, QED, SA, affinity} × {E1,E2,E3} (12 configs) | Component contributions, shortcut detection |
| **A2** | Full multi-property feedback (fixed weights), mid β, constant schedule, E1/E2/E3 | Main "full feedback" effect |
| **A3** | β sweep {0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0} (mid = A2) × E1/E2/E3 | Feedback-strength tradeoff curve |
| **A4** | Schedule {constant, linear ramp, warmup-hold, anneal, curriculum QED→SA→affinity} × E1/E3 | Feedback schedule |
| **A5** | Diversity-preserving feedback: (i) intra-batch ECFP4 dissimilarity repulsion, (ii) quality-diversity islands / constrained Pareto (diversity as constraint) × E1/E3 | "feedback helps" **vs** "feedback + diversity mechanism helps" ka separation |
| **A6** | **Post-hoc top-k filter on A0 samples, output count exactly matched** to feedback-arm output (composite-score ranking) | Truncation-vs-distribution-shift control (load-bearing) |
| **A7** | Placebo: shuffled-reward + identity-reward | Content-specificity control |
| **A8** | Docking-in-loop (Vina as inner-loop reward, small budget) | Surrogate-fidelity upper reference |
| **X-PANEL** | Optional: A2/A5 on a 2–4 target panel | target-agnostic-repeat hallucination metric |

**Scale (proposed planning arithmetic, ek consistency script se — benchmark nahi):** 39 training configs × seeds (5 primary / 3 sweep) = **161 training runs** + **10 eval-only A6 conditions** = **171 evaluation conditions**; ~**7.6M** generator forward-outputs (E2 arms ka 10× oversampling included); docking audit tier = 13 configs × 3 seeds = 39 runs × 1,000 ligands = **39,000 dockings + 39,000 rescorings**; ~**3,864 KS tests** (12 descriptors × 161 runs × 2 regimes) → multiple-testing correction anivarya; 322 MMD comparisons (2,000×2,000 kernel subsample).

---

## 4. Metrics battery

**(a) Validity / valence (H2 primary):** RDKit sanitization pass rate, per-error-class valence-failure counts, SMILES parse/canonicalization success, disconnected-fragment (".") rate.

**(b) Property scores (H1):** QED, cLogP, MW, TPSA, HBA/HBD, rotatable bonds, SA score, **Lipophilicity Efficiency (LE = cLogP/heavy-atom count)**, target-tier: Vina score + independent rescoring. **Composite property score** pre-specified: `0.4·QED_norm + 0.3·(1−SA_norm) + 0.3·affinity_norm` (weights = proposed design parameters; univariate results separately reported as secondaries).

**(c) Diversity (H3):** **internal diversity** = mean pairwise 1−Tanimoto (ECFP4, r=2); **scaffold diversity** = unique Bemis–Murcko scaffolds per 1k, effective scaffold number (exp(entropy)), scaffold-frequency Gini; ECFP4 distinct-mer count; top-1000-pairs self-overlap; nearest-neighbor-Tanimoto histogram (train vs generated).

**(d) Structural-artifact / long-chain detector (regime-conditional):** longest **linear carbon-chain length** distribution; fraction with chain > reference-corpus **q99**; alkyl-only/"fatty-acid-like" fraction (sp3-carbon fraction > threshold ∧ ring count = 0); chain-length↔cLogP coupling slope; **cLogP-gain attribution (mediation) regression** — total cLogP gain ka kitna hissa sirf chain-length inflation + heavy-atom count hai (pre-specified). **Verdict rule:** artifact flagged **only relative to the regime used as reference** (R-BIO par chain-inflation penalty active; R-MK par wahi molecules out-of-support nahi hongi → inversion reported).

**(e) "Molecular hallucination" — 4-component operational battery:**
- **PRIMARY (per researcher resolution 3):** **H-P1 out-of-reference-support** (support = union of R-BIO central-95% quantile bands on 12 descriptors; Mahalanobis-outlier test in descriptor space) **+ H-P2 valence/sanitization invalid**.
- **SECONDARY/exploratory:** **H-S1 synthesability-undefined/unmakeable** (SA > threshold, non-sanitizable after tautomer canonicalization, unmakeability flag); **H-S2 target-agnostic repeats** (same/near-duplicate scaffold high-affinity across unrelated targets — fully defined only under X-PANEL).
- **MANDATORY reward-hacking diagnostic:** **surrogate→independent-rescoring transfer gap** = (surrogate-predicted affinity gain) − (Vina + independent-rescoring affinity gain). Agar surrogate gain bina real gain ke → N-hacking supported, H1 **fails** chahe reward kitna bhi improve ho.

**(f) Distribution alignment (H3), per regime:** per-descriptor **KS** D + p; histogram **Wasserstein-1/EMD**; **MMD** (ECFP4-Tanimoto kernel ek, GIN-embedding kernel dusra) with permutation p; **JSD/KL** on scaffold-frequency distribution; **quantile-calibration** = fraction inside reference central-95% band (per descriptor); "realism" discriminator AUC (generated-vs-corpus, cross-validated) — lower AUC = better alignment.

---

## 5. Endpoints

**PRIMARY joint endpoint (pre-registered, single scalar per arm×seed) — "Qualified-Hit Fraction with diversity floor" (QHF-DF):**
```
QHF-DF = 0                                            if ID(arm) < f_div · ID(A0)      [diversity floor gate]
       = fraction of generated molecules that are valid ∧ novel (NN-Tanimoto < 0.4 to train)
         ∧ in-R-BIO-support ∧ composite ≥ τ_c         otherwise
```
`f_div = 0.85`, `τ_c` = pilot-A0 se frozen composite cut — **dono pre-registered proposed design parameters**. Ye joint construction isliye, kyunki property-only metric truncation/mode-collapse ko reward kar dega. **Sensitivity (added after a logic check of the gate):** f_div ∈ {0.70, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90}; ek fixed floor A5-jaisi arms ko artificially zero kar sakta hai jabki diversity loss genuine tradeoff hai, isliye primary verdict f_div-sweep ke under report hoga (robustness = same sign across floors) aur gated arms ka raw composite bhi reported hoga.

**Key secondaries (pre-registered):** (S1) composite property score; (S2) hallucination primary components (H-P1, H-P2); (S3) internal + scaffold diversity; (S4) per-regime KS/MMD/calibration; (S5) long-chain artifact fraction per regime; (S6) transfer gap (reward-hacking diagnostic).

**Pre-registered decision matrix:** H1 supported = A2 > A0 *and* A2 > A6 *and* transfer gap > 0. H3 supported = A2/A5 alignment better than A0 on R-BIO *and* ID ≥ floor *and* long-chain artifact fraction not increased on R-BIO. H2 supported = hallucination primary rate lower than A0 **and than A7-placebo**. "Feedback embedding (not filtering)" ki claim tabhi supported jab A2 > A6 by pre-set margin — A6, E1-vs-E2 comparison se bhi stronger single control hai.

---

## 6. Analysis plan

- **Seeds/pairing:** 5 seeds (primary arms), 3 (sweeps); same seed set across arms (paired design). Scaffold-disjoint train/test split aur evaluation reference sets sab arms ke liye fixed (seed-independent data).
- **Inference:** paired-seed contrasts → **stratified permutation / Wilcoxon** (n=5 par parametric t nahi), effect size **Cliff's delta**; **bootstrap 95% CIs** (10k resamples; diversity metrics par scaffold-stratified resampling taaki pseudoreplication na ho).
- **Multiple testing:** **Holm–Bonferroni within each endpoint family**, **BH-FDR q=0.05** across the ~3,864-test descriptor battery; post-hoc tuning se bachne ke liye primary endpoint ek hi hai, baaki sab pre-declared secondary.
- **Trend analysis:** β-sweep par monotonicity/isotonic check; **β_crit** = maximum β jahan ID ≥ floor (interpreted tradeoff, pre-specified); schedule × β interaction test.
- **Mediation:** property/cLogP gain → chain-length + heavy-atom mediation; **artifact-adjusted property gain** report (artifact contribution subtract karke).
- **Pareto reporting (mandatory):** har arm×seed (property, diversity, alignment) 3-D space me; **dominance relations + Pareto front per regime**; single scalar ke alawa sawaal "kya koi feedback arm A0 ko teeno axes par Pareto-dominates karta hai?" — sabse honest answer, aur single-metric failure ko expose karta hai.
- **Attribution summary:** component (A1) × injection (E1/E2/E3) × β × schedule ka factorial-effect table, A7-placebo ke对照 differences ke saath.

---

## 7. Feasibility (CPU-only reality se honest tie) + required external provisions

**Observed environment (verified):** `/workspace` me sirf `task.json`; **RDKit/Vina/Open Babel/numpy/torch sab missing**; **network blocked** (DNS fail); **no GPU**; 224 CPU cores, ~2 TB RAM. → Design isi environment me executable nahi hai; neeche ki provisions ise resolve karti hain (isliye design "infeasible in this environment" nahi dikhega bina bataye).

**Budget-limiting tiers (proposed planning arithmetic, benchmarked nahi):**
1. **Training (dominant cost):** ~**1,000–3,900 core-hours** for 161 runs; CPU-only ≈ **60–240 h wall** at 16-way parallelism. → Mitigation: **pre-registered "must-run core" subset** (~32 runs: A0, A1-{QED,affinity}, A2×3, A3 mid/high β, A5×2, A6×2, A7×2, A8×1) taaki budget contraction pre-planned ho, post-hoc nahi.
2. **Docking audit (224 cores par limiting NAHI):** 39,000 dockings + 39,000 rescorings @ ~2 s = **~22 core-hours ≈ ~6 min wall** at full core count; ligand prep (tautomer/protonation/3D embed) 2–5× overhead dega. **Ceiling: ≤ 60,000 docking calls study-wide**; A8 docking-in-loop ke liye alag **≤ 5,000** cap (single receptor, pre-computed grid).
3. **Descriptor/fingerprint scoring:** RDKit par SA non-trivial → SA precompute + cache, descriptors 32-way sharded; hours-scale, non-limiting.
4. **MMD/KS battery:** 322 MMD comparisons, 2,000×2,000 fixed-seed subsample → hours-scale, non-limiting.

**Required external provisions (consolidated; in-workspace available NAHI):**
1. **Software env:** RDKit (+Mordred), Open Babel, AutoDock Vina/smina, numpy/scipy/pandas/scikit-learn, torch, PyG — **pinned versions** (Vina scores versions ke beech unstable hote hain → version lock + fixed poses par rescoring).
2. **Generator code + checkpoints**, ya public training corpus (ZINC-like) se pretrain ka budget.
3. **Reference corpora:** ChEMBL-like bioactive set (R-BIO) + Enamine-REAL-like/GDB-style makeable set (R-MK), license-cleared.
4. **Receptor structure + prepared binding-site grid** (single target) + docking config; optional panel ke liye 2–4 targets.
5. **Trained affinity surrogate** + ek **independent** scoring function (transfer-gap diagnostic ke liye non-negotiable).
6. SA-score contribution tables, ECFP4/GIN embedding assets, aur "must-run core" ko cover karta hua compute allocation.

---

## 8. Open clarifications, apnaye gaye defaults ke saath (assumption vs brief-se-fixed)

| # | Open clarification | **Adopted default** | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Docking budget; single vs panel target | Audit-only docking ≤60k calls; **single receptor**; panel = optional X-PANEL | Assumption (panel-optional = researcher resolution 4) |
| 2 | Surrogate vs oracle in loop; refresh allowed? | Surrogate in loop (static), **2 refresh checkpoints** ka A2-variant; A8 = docking-in-loop | Assumption |
| 3 | Mandated injection point? | **Not fixed → primary factor E1/E2/E3** | Assumption (researcher resolution 1) |
| 4 | Model family / checkpoints / generation budget | GFlowNet-TB + RL-Transformer, ≤50M, 10k molecules/run | Assumption |
| 5 | Hallucination primary component | **H-P1 out-of-support + H-P2 valence = primary**; H-S1/H-S2 secondary; transfer gap **mandatory** | Adopted per researcher resolution 3 |
| 6 | "Real-world" = drug-like ya makeable? | **R-BIO primary, R-MK secondary + regime-interaction analysis** | Adopted per researcher resolution 2 |
| 7 | Diversity floor value (self-raised) | f_div = 0.85 primary + {0.70, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90} sensitivity | Design-parameter assumption (gate-logic check ke baad added) |

**Fixed by brief/task:** property set (p-logP, QED, binding affinity); diversity preservation aur long-chain over-representation avoidance; real-world-distribution alignment; design-only constraint ("do not claim that an experiment was run"); koi dataset/codebase provided nahi.
**Assumptions (fixed nahi):** upar ki table ke rows 1–4, §2 ke model/target/corpora choices, saare numeric thresholds, CPU-viability estimates.

---

## 9. Known design weaknesses (self-reported)
(i) **CPU-only me RL fine-tuning dominant cost** hai → reduced-seed contraction pre-registered. (ii) **Vina ka score real binding free energy nahi** → affinity component "predicted affinity" hi rahega; transfer gap isko partially guard karta hai, poora nahi. (iii) **f_div gate A5 ko artificially penalize kar sakta hai** → sensitivity sweep added. (iv) **Surrogate-exploitation puri tarah eliminate nahi**, sirf measurable. (v) **Corpus composition hi "artifact" ki paribhasha badal deta hai** (regime inversion) → isliye dual-regime mandatory.

context.question: Incorporating the chemical feedback mechanism, which leverages properties such as p-logP, QED, and binding affinity, directly improves the generation of molecules with superior chemical properties and reduces molecular hallucinations in targeted molecule discovery tasks. Does embedding this feedback loop better align molecule generation with real-world distributions, preserving structural diversity (e.g., avoiding over-representation of ultra-long carbon chains) while enhancing property scores?
context.context: Design an experiment that answers the question. The researcher can clarify source-supported setup details by topic. Do not claim that an experiment was run.
